queryProtocol.maximum: positive MWI; previous < peak >= next; peak <= pre-step opening half-threshold
queryProtocol.alignment: earliest absolute bandpass maximum in trailing MWI window
queryProtocol.timing: first available sample after confirmation and complete aligned +/-80ms vector; before current emission learning
queryProtocol.scope: all signal-derived below-opening maxima after calibration, including refractory/candidate neighborhoods
queryProtocol.scoring: posthoc +/-150ms; unique baseline misses; mature proposals greedy one-to-one to baseline misses

energyProtocol.statistic: centered mean-square of the same +/-80ms bandpass vector that is shape-normalized
energyProtocol.prior: EMA (updateWeight) of emitted energies plus min/max since template creation

analysisProtocol.scale: log2(query energy / prior template energy); never thresholded
analysisProtocol.populations: mature-match queries only; paired = one-to-one to baseline misses; unmatched strata as in the query report
analysisProtocol.statistic: P(L_paired > L_other) with ties 0.5, descriptive overlap only

contextProtocol.prior: latest valid emission strictly before queriedAt; current pipeline-step excluded; gap clears state; warmup included
contextProtocol.primaryClock: queriedAt - previous.emittedAt; positive decision elapsed, not estimated-sample refractory elapsed
contextProtocol.diagnosticClock: candidate.t - previous.event.t; signed; never used to stratify or decide
contextProtocol.bins: left-inclusive right-exclusive; null upper edge = infinity; missing decision = separate bin
contextProtocol.primaryComparison: paired baseline misses vs noReferenceNeighborhood; control is primary bank
contextProtocol.direction: higher energy and higher decision elapsed prespecified; support nonmonotonic fixed-bin proportions only
contextProtocol.closure: >=3 eligible non228 records with >=3 valid energy+elapsed per primary group; energy and elapsed AUC>0.5 in every eligible record; same joint cell eligible in >=3 non228 records and energy AUC>0.5 in all its eligible records; sparse = inconclusive
contextProtocol.interpretation: conditional descriptive association only; no score, predictive fit, incremental performance proof or threshold

control.limit: No predictive fit: neither conditional nor marginal AUC proves incremental multifeature performance

cap2.limit: No predictive fit: neither conditional nor marginal AUC proves incremental multifeature performance
